In addition to the references appearing in the text, we have included a
        number of textbooks and monographs for general reference. One category
        is books on finite element methods and includes (Aubin 1980), (Axelsson &

        cludes (Ciarlet 1988), (Gilbarg & Trudinger 1983), (Lions & Magenes 1972),
        (Showalter 1977), (Sobolev 1964), (Taylor 1996), (Wendland 1979) and
        (Wloka 1987).
